task.title: WidgetSpec v2 / ChartSpec / DashboardRecipe v2 CRUD + concurrency
task.summary_zh: 依 contract-closure 04_dashboard_crud_and_concurrency.md 把 dashboard-recipe CRUD 路由補進 agora_v1_1.openapi.yaml(strategies/{id}/dashboard-recipes、/proposals、recipe accept/layout(PATCH)/rollback/feedback/versions、widgets/validate、widgets/{id}/feedback、widgets/propose-plugin),與 AG-XR-OPENAPI-001 共寫同一 yaml 但只新增 dashboard 區塊、不更動 servant/workshop 區塊以減少衝突。version 為 append-only(dashboard_recipe_identity/dashboard_recipe_version,recipe_id+version PK,rollback 產生新版本不抹歷史);ETag recipe:<id>:v<version>:<content_sha256-prefix>,state-changing 需 If-Match + Idempotency-Key + body expected_version,衝突回 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION 帶 current_etag/latest_href;layout patch 僅允許 move/resize/remove/add_registered/replace_chart_spec/update_widget_query 並對 WidgetRegistry/scope/bounds 驗證;新增 agora.dashboard.v2 capability。WidgetSpec v2 / ChartSpec v1 / DashboardRecipe v2 沿用 AG-XR-001A 的 v2 schema 接上路由。 【有疑問一定要提出,不要自己亂做】動工前先讀完 contract-closure 文件(docs/04/pantheon_agora_cross_repo_2026-06-20/contract-closure/ 01-07 + v2 schema + ARCHIVE_NOTES.md)與 frozen 基線(services/control-plane/specs/agora/ + openapi/agora_v1.openapi.yaml + bundle_index.json)。prose 03/04 為合約權威,agora_openapi_extension_v1_1.yaml 只是 seed(24/32 route)不可照抄當完整契約。只要遇到任何疑問、設計沒寫到、與既有 code 對不上、依賴不清或衝突,一律 STOP 開 blocker 等澄清,不可臆測、補洞、繞過。鐵律:不得改動 frozen AG-XR-001 檔案、不得讓其 bundle_index.json sha256 失效、不得擴張 capability allowlist、不得讓 Agora 直接下單/綁資金/寫 RuntimeBinding。
acceptance: doc 04 的 dashboard CRUD + ETag/If-Match/Idempotency-Key/expected_version/409 並發契約全到位;版本 append-only 且 rollback 不抹歷史;layout patch op allowlist 受驗;agora.dashboard.v2 宣告;引用 v2 schema;【驗收】frozen v1 檔案與 bundle_index.json sha256 不變(agora_schema_bundle.py --verify 仍綠);新增物逐欄位對齊 contract-closure prose;遇疑問先 blocker 不自行實作
